texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.Share any previous work you're proud of: I run a production multi-machine Claude agent fleet (6 machines, 100+ automation routines), operated in public: consensus, CRM, persistent memory, published evals. Flagships: claw-consensus (reproducible multi-machine agent consensus, offline demo, FAILURE-MODES.md) and verbatim-citation-gate (zero-token gate that catches fabricated RAG citations, MIT). Before the agent era I built the automation myself: wrote my own CRM (roots: 5 years building ERP/CRM on Salesforce and Microsoft Navision at Merlion) with social enrichment, parsing at scale and lead-to-call pipelines - up to 30 operators worked in it daily; today it is AI-native. Pre-sales muscle: 15+ years founder/BD, 10,000+ founder calls and 2,000+ institutional-investor calls - I can demo, scope and ship the workflow in the same meeting.
texts.Anything: US work authorization: active O-1 visa - authorized to work in the US, no sponsorship needed (that is why the visa checkbox above is unchecked). Based between Palo Alto, CA and Lisbon; available immediately and happy to work in person in San Francisco. Links: https://tonydzi.github.io/ and https://github.com/tonydzi (no LinkedIn account - the URL field points to my site).
